newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Daehan Flour passes on 24,500T of wheat tenders.
newsitem.headline: Daehan Flour passes on 24,500T of wheat tenders.

text.p: South Korea's Daehan Flour Mills Co Ltd said on Wednesday it passed on tenders to buy 24,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat due to high offer prices.
A Daehan official said it will re-invite the tenders by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Friday.

The official said the total amount would be split into four postions -- 11,000 tonnes of western white/soft white, 1,000 tonnes of western white (protein minimum 10 percent), 2,000 tonnes of hard red winter (protein minimum 11.5 percent), and 10,500 tonnes of dark northern spring (protein minimum 14 percent).
Shipment was set for May 1-30 to the western port of Inchon.
